## Checklist

- [ ] Added row(s) to `protocols.csv`
- [ ] `Protocol ID` follows the format `PLATFORM-HARDWARE-MODALITY-TEST` (uppercase, hyphen-separated)
- [ ] `Date of Test` is in `YYYY-MM-DD` format
- [ ] `Platform` and `Hardware` columns filled correctly
- [ ] `Procedure` column describes a physical action, not a software state
- [ ] `Expected Behavior` uses SDK flag names where relevant
- [ ] `Contributed By` includes lab/institution and year
- [ ] I physically ran this test myself (not inferred from documentation)
- [ ] `Data URL` filled if raw data is available (optional but encouraged)
